writer_policy: one bounded writer lane per canonical project checkout/repo area; specialists may research/review concurrently but must not edit overlapping files

chat_policy.default: one durable home conversation per canonical project checkout
chat_policy.reuse: reuse the healthy home conversation for subsequent bounded work items; for Synapse ChatGPT-Web prefer reuse_chat_from_work_item_id when available
chat_policy.replacement: create a replacement only when the home chat is missing, inaccessible, corrupted, length-limited, or explicitly separated by the user
chat_policy.retirement: persist the replacement home identity before archiving temporary/retired worker records; archive real provider conversations only from exact known identifiers and never from approximate title matching

checkpoint_triggers: 70 percent of configured soft time budget
70 percent of configured material action budget
before a known batch or turn boundary
resume_protocol: load Synapse orientation and project AI context
load project-local loop state and latest checkpoint
reinspect repository status, runtime health, and concurrent writers
continue the checkpointed in-progress iteration before selecting a new one
rerun only the minimum evidence needed to detect material drift
checkpoint again before the next risky execution boundary
continue_only_if: project goal is not yet satisfied
no user decision or secret is required
verification gates can still be run honestly
the next iteration is materially connected to the project goal
hard_stop_conditions: credential, payment, legal acceptance, production data deletion, or other consequential external action needs human authorization
two consecutive failed or non-improving iterations by default
baseline is too broken or ambiguous to attribute the proposed change safely
a concurrent writer owns the same files or worktree lane
verification evidence contradicts the claimed improvement
scope has drifted away from the declared project goal
success_rule: Never mark an iteration improved from self-description, transport text, worker disappearance, or chat completion alone. Require task-proportionate evidence from tests, build output, runtime/browser/playtest observation, static checks, or other objective project proof.
resume_query: Use `resume-plan` to get the latest checkpoint, exact next action, in-progress iteration, budget snapshot, chat home, and archive queue size in one machine-readable response.
